name: The Night They Drove Old Dixie Down

podcast.body: This song was released in September 1969, featuring lead vocals by Leavon Helm, the band's only American member from Arkansas. Helm's gritty, gravelly voice perfectly conveys the pain of the lyrics, which are sung from the perspective of a defeated white southerner reflecting on the end of the Civil War in 1865. The narrator, Virgil Cane, laments the destruction around him but resolves to continue working the land. The song reflects a sense of pain and loss, mirroring the feelings of many white southerners in the early 1970s who found their changing landscape unrecognizable. "The night they drove Old Dixie down, you know, that's a song of pain."
